solution.approach: In this paper, we propose a novel fusion approach named Pointbased Attentive Cont-conv Fusion(PACF) module, which fuses multi-sensor features directly on 3D points.

evidence.quote: In this paper, we propose a novel fusion approach named Pointbased Attentive Cont-conv Fusion(PACF) module, which fuses multi-sensor features directly on 3D points.
Moreover, based on the PACF module, we propose a 3D multi-sensor multi-task network called PointcloudImage RCNN(PI-RCNN as brief), which handles the image segmentation and 3D object detection tasks.
We demonstrate the effectiveness of the PACF module and PI-RCNN on the KITTI 3D Detection benchmark, and our method can achieve stateof-the-art on the metric of 3D AP.
